mission_texts: phone
General-purpose phone. Share user-selected everyday observations without assuming an emergency.
incident_phone
Citizen incident reporting phone. Document visible incidents and useful changes for local response.
damage_drone
Aerial structural inspection drone. Identify visible building damage and newly exposed structural evidence.
person_drone
Person-search drone. Locate visible people and evidence relevant to search without assuming distress.
flood_drone
Flood and evacuation drone. Observe inundation and passable or blocked evacuation routes.
fire_drone
Wildfire observation drone. Observe visible smoke and flame and supported changes near infrastructure.
road_drone
Road and bridge drone. Inspect transport structures and visible obstruction or damage.
car
Ordinary connected-car camera. Observe immediate road conditions and travel obstacles.
response_car
Emergency vehicle camera. Report response access and visible incident developments.
traffic_cctv
Fixed intersection CCTV. Observe traffic flow, collisions and obstructions.
public_cctv
Fixed public-space CCTV. Observe visible incidents and crowd changes without inferring danger from occupancy.
water_camera
Fixed river and underpass camera. Observe water and route conditions without inferring physical depth.
robot
Industrial inspection robot. Report visible equipment and area conditions on its inspection route.
farm_drone
Agricultural survey drone. Observe crop and field conditions and supported changes.
maintenance
Infrastructure maintenance camera. Document inspection findings, repair evidence and relevant changes.
